overview: The board approved a special permit for a home addition at 86 Suffolk Street and denied a variance for a covered porch at 133 Century Street Extension. Members also reviewed meeting minutes and a proposal to update the board's rules and regulations.

items.title: 86 Suffolk Street - Case A-2024-17
items.summary: Approved a special permit for a 264-square-foot addition extending an existing rear yard nonconformity, while continuing a related variance request to the next meeting pending updated plot plans.

items.title: 133 Century Street Extension - Case A-2024-18
items.summary: Denied a variance for an eight-foot-deep covered front porch that would have encroached into the 15-foot front yard setback on a private way.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Minutes
items.summary: Approved the June 27 meeting minutes and discussed a recommendation from the Building Commissioner to appoint a subcommittee to update the board's dated rules and regulations.
